# Habakkuk Chapter 3 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HAB_003_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**3:2** YHWH, I-have-heard [shamati] your-report [shim'akha]; I-fear [yareiti], YHWH, your-work [po'olkha]. In-the-midst [be-qerev] of-the-years [shanim] revive-it [chayeihu]; in-the-midst of-the-years make-it-known [todia]; in-wrath [be-rogez] remember [tizkor] compassion [rachem].

**3:17** Though the-fig-tree [te'enah] does-not blossom [lo tifreach] and-there-is-no fruit [yevul] on-the-vines [ba-gefenamim]; the-work [ma'aseh] of-the-olive [zayit] fails [kichesh] and-the-fields [shedemot] produce [asah] no food [okhel]; the-flock [tson] is-cut-off [gazar] from-the-fold [mi-mikhlah] and-there-is-no herd [baqar] in-the-stalls [ba-refatim] —

**3:18** yet-I will-rejoice [e'elozah] in-YHWH; I-will-be-joyful [agilah] in-the-God of-my-salvation [yish'i].

**3:19** The-Lord [Adonai] YHWH [is] my-strength [cheili]; he-makes [vayyasem] my-feet [raglai] like-the-deer's [ka-ayyalot]; and-upon my-high-places [bamotai] he-makes-me-walk [yadrikheni].
